protocol: Five sequential repeats, reset before each edit; performance.now send to setData plus next requestAnimationFrame. No warm-up edits.
draw_note: Ends after setData and next animation frame as specified; does not wait for GPU completion or source idle.

load.resource_size_note: Browser Resource Timing values; zero may mean cache or missing Timing-Allow-Origin. Excludes tiles.
load.cold_load_note: Harness cannot verify a cold cache. Disable cache and reload before measuring.

raster_fallback.requirements: Visible attribution, honour cache headers, valid Referer, no bulk download or offline prefetch; heavy usage may be blocked.

heap_note: Main-page performance.memory only, sampled every 100 ms and at phase boundaries; not an instrumented worker/process peak. Null when unavailable.
